author: Rahul kp
title: Forfeit and Reissue
hook: cancel it, then sell it again!
simple_words: Defaulter's shares are cancelled; money already paid is kept, and the shares can be sold again.

definitions.meaning: Company cancels shares for non-payment of call money. Share capital is debited by the called-up amount; amount received is kept.
definitions.note: Debit capital at CALLED-UP, not issue price

definitions.meaning: Sale of forfeited shares again. Any discount allowed is charged to Forfeited Shares A/c; the surplus left goes to Capital Reserve.

key_points: Forfeiture entry: Share Capital Dr (called-up), to Calls in Arrear and ==Forfeited Shares A/c== (amount received).
If premium was not received, debit ==Securities Premium== also. If it was received, it is not reversed.
On reissue, Share Capital is credited with the ==paid-up value== given to the new holder, even if cash is lower.
!!Discount on reissue cannot exceed the forfeited amount of those shares!!.

formulas.name: Forfeited Shares A/c credit
formulas.legend: Called-up face value = share capital debited. Unpaid calls = calls in arrear on face value. Premium is handled separately.

formulas.name: Capital Reserve on reissue
formulas.legend: F = forfeited balance for the shares reissued only (pro rata, if part reissued). D = discount allowed on reissue.

insight.punchline: Only the gain stays as reserve!
insight.text: After reissue, the Forfeited Shares balance left for those shares moves to Capital Reserve.

memory_trick.explanation: Cancel at called-up. Keep money received in Forfeited A/c. Sell again with any discount. Save leftover gain in Capital Reserve.

exam_tip: In part reissue, take only the matching share of the Forfeited balance to Capital Reserve. Leave the rest in the account.

doubt.question: Is the premium reversed when shares are forfeited?
doubt.answer: Only if it was not received. Premium already received is not reversed. If it is unpaid, debit Securities Premium.

mistakes.wrong: Debiting Share Capital with the full face value on forfeiture
mistakes.right: Debit only the called-up amount. Uncalled amount was never recorded as capital.

mistakes.wrong: Crediting Forfeited Shares A/c with the called-up amount
mistakes.right: Credit it with the amount actually received on face value. Unpaid calls are credited separately.

mistakes.wrong: Reversing premium already received on forfeiture
mistakes.right: Reverse Securities Premium only if it was not received. Received premium stays.

mistakes.wrong: Transferring the full Forfeited A/c balance to Capital Reserve on part reissue
mistakes.right: Transfer only the balance for reissued shares, after discount. Keep the rest.
